projects.title: How big it is!
projects.description: The largest screen in the world of cinematography – IMAX – is coming to Kosovo for the first time. This is a major event that needs to be emphasized, therefore we have created a provocative concept.

data.content: The largest screen in the world of cinema, iMAX, was coming to Kosovë for the first time, at the “Cineplex” cinema, and among the first in the region.
This was a grand event that had to be highlighted, as it offered a unique and extraordinary experience, completely different from anything we had seen before.
We came with a provocative concept that sparked great curiosity and fueled discussions, reaching a wide audience.
The words 'How Big' and 'Majestic' started to dominate the internet, becoming highly provocative and triggering discussions that spread everywhere.
We fully executed the iMAX campaign, creating all the accompanying design materials, from TV commercials to outdoor and social media content.
